CreateUnit.description: Create one Footman for Player 1 at the map origin. These snippets run inside an initialized map, such as a trigger action.

TimerStart.description: Run a one-shot callback after one second and destroy the timer when it fires. The JASS callback must be declared before the code that starts the timer.
TimerStart.jass:
function ExampleTimerElapsed takes nothing returns nothing
    call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
endfunction

function ExampleStartTimer takes nothing returns nothing
    local timer t = CreateTimer()
    call TimerStart(t, 1.0, false, function ExampleTimerElapsed)
    set t = null
endfunction
TimerStart.lua:
local t = CreateTimer()
TimerStart(t, 1.0, false, function()
    DestroyTimer(t)
end)

GetSpellAbilityId.description: Inside a spell-effect trigger action, filter for a custom ability. Replace A000 with your map’s ability raw code.
GetSpellAbilityId.lua:
if GetSpellAbilityId() == FourCC("A000") then
    -- Add behavior for this spell here.
end

DisplayTimedTextToPlayer.description: Show a message to Player 1 for ten seconds. Call after the loading screen; see the Lua harness guide for a delayed start example.

UnitAddAbility.description: Give a unit an existing custom ability. Replace A000 with the ability raw code; caster must be a unit already in your map.

RemoveLocation.description: Remove a temporary location once you have used it. The coordinates remain ordinary numbers.
RemoveLocation.jass:
local location point = Location(128.0, 256.0)
local real x = GetLocationX(point)
call RemoveLocation(point)
set point = null
RemoveLocation.lua:
local point = Location(128.0, 256.0)
local x = GetLocationX(point)
RemoveLocation(point)

Player.description: Player indices are zero-based: Player(0) is Player 1. Do not use this as a promise about which slots are occupied.

DestroyGroup.description: Destroy a temporary unit group after use. Destroying the group does not remove its units.
DestroyGroup.jass:
local group temporary = CreateGroup()
call DestroyGroup(temporary)
set temporary = null
